source_full_text: Whilst he himself retired with Labakan to his own rooms, full of anger with the queen his wife, In spite of their many years of happy life together. The queen, on her side, was plunged in grief, For she felt certain that an impostor had won her husband's heart and taken the place of her real son.

reference_text: 尽管他自己带着拉巴坎退入自己的房间，心中充满对妻子王后的愤怒，尽管他们曾共同度过了许多幸福的岁月。王后这边则深陷悲痛之中，因为她确信一个冒牌货已经夺走了丈夫的心，取代了她真正的儿子。
